g.text: Same 1,713 original-target circuits · mapping217 · ExtraTrees300 · five leakage-closed folds · all three paired seeds (2026101421/22/23)
Primary mean across the three paired seeds: log1p − raw = +0.242307 LUT4. All three seed contrasts are positive.
Dots in B–C show every seed; bars and labels are descriptive three-seed means. No best seed, error-bar inference or population confidence interval.
OOF predictions use held-out leakage groups. Both targets retain the original-graph zero override; the log predictor decodes expm1 of the forest mean log prediction.
Fitting-only consumed development; no new evaluation labels, final refit, calibration, acquisition policy, CPU or independent-transfer claim. Full precision and source hashes: figure-data.json.
